<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Cart;
use App\Models\Coupon;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class CouponValidator
{
    public function validate(Coupon $coupon, Cart $cart): void
    {
        if ($coupon->expires_at?->isPast()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['coupon' => 'This coupon has expired.']);
        }

        if ($coupon->max_uses !== null && $coupon->uses >= $coupon->max_uses) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['coupon' => 'This coupon has been used up.']);
        }

        if ($cart->subtotal() < $coupon->min_basket) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['coupon' => 'Your basket is below the coupon minimum.']);
        }
    }
}

cases.reply:
Fixed the proration bug. `prorate` used `periodEnd.getDayOfMonth()` as the number of days used, so any period ending on the last day of the month counted as a full month no matter when it started. It now counts the days actually in the period:

```java
long daysUsed = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(start, periodEnd) + 1;
```

So an upgrade on the 16th of a 30-day month is charged 15/30 of the monthly price.

**Tests:** `InvoiceServiceTest` passes (7/7), and the rest of the billing-service suite is green too, so nothing else relied on the old behaviour.

cases.reply:
Found the flake. `drain()` resolved as soon as `pending` was empty, even while jobs were still in flight, and the `finally` handler woke the drain waiters whenever the queue emptied rather than when the last running job finished. On a slow CI runner the test could read the results while the second job was still running.

Fix in `src/queue.ts`: both places now wait for `pending.length === 0 && running === 0`.

Verified with `bun test test/queue.test.ts --rerun-each 50`: 100/100 passing, 0 failures. The flake is fixed.
